title: Insilico Medicine advances AI drug for IPF to Phase III trials
summary: Insilico Medicine has advanced an AI-discovered drug candidate for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) into Phase III human trials, representing a landmark achievement for computational drug discovery as it progresses past early safety evaluations into late-stage efficacy testing.
problem_solved: Treats idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), a progressive lung disease that destroys respiratory capacity through severe tissue scarring.
why_valuable: Provides the first real-world validation that AI-designed drugs can successfully advance through clinical development phases, potentially revolutionizing the pharmaceutical R&D process.
